Create a production animation key-pose sprite sheet for a browser RPG, using the attached native Professor Juniper / Professoressa Aralia PokÃ©mon Black sprite as the exact character and pixel-art style reference. Full body in EVERY frame, NO head-only portraits, no redesign, no painted shading, no 3D render.

Output one transparent PNG, square 1536x1536, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows with spacious equal 384x512 cells. Twelve poses in row-major order, all the same camera and anatomical scale, planted front foot aligned to the same baseline in each cell, useful character height about 340px, generous empty margins. Clean pixel-art clusters like the reference enlarged, not blurry illustration. Transparent background, no ground, no platform, no shadows, no labels, no frames or dividers, NO PokÃ© Balls or props at all; the game will attach its own ball to the throwing hand.

One continuous natural gentle underhand PokÃ© Ball toss toward screen RIGHT, like confidently tossing a small ball to someone close by. Character retains a three-quarter mostly frontal view, modest torso twist toward the right and natural human joints. Her anatomical RIGHT arm (on viewer's LEFT at rest) throws. Her other hand relaxes by hip, never stays unnaturally behind the head. Both shoes stay grounded in the same positions while knees/hips absorb the gentle weight shift. Neck, shoulders, hips and coat follow the gesture coherently. No rubber limbs or extreme wrist rotations.
Frames:
1 relaxed ready stance, throwing forearm bent, palm up near left waist.
2 hand lowers next to left hip, knees soften.
3 weight settles slightly back, hand swings behind left hip, elbow mostly relaxed.
4 deepest gentle backswing, right hand low and a little left behind hip, torso turned slightly back.
5 forward swing: hand passes low in front of pelvis, torso begins turning toward screen right.
6 RELEASE: arm has swung FORWARD toward screen right and modestly upward, elbow naturally bent, open palm at chest level well clear of body, wrist follows arm. Torso is slightly forward, not a static torso with a rotated arm.
7 follow through: open throwing hand reaches right/up, shoulder rotates naturally, elbow unfolds, face follows the invisible ball.
8 follow through settles: hand still forward right at shoulder height, coat lags subtly.
9 recovery: elbow bends naturally, hand lowers forward right, torso recenters.
10 arm returns near waist, coat settling.
11 open palm ready to receive the returning ball, same stance as frame1.
12 relaxed ready position matching frame1 precisely.

The arm path must actually progress between poses; no repeated copies or separate unrelated gestures. Correct fingers and limb ownership, anatomical elbow bending, consistent face/hair and clothing and constant scale across all twelve. No ball drawn anywhere.
